The old love for Salve prevails, however, and Elisabeth spurns the officer, but Salve has already left his native land in desperation and is sailing toward foreign shores. When he finally, after some years, returns to his old home, he finds that Elisabeth, after all, has been true to him. He marries her.

The narrative shifts focus between their strained marriage at the harbor town of Merdoe and the contrasting life of Carl Beck in Frederiksvaern, where he is a wealthy shipbuilder known as "the pink of chivalry" toward his cold, precise wife, Fru Beck.

However, Elizabeth refuses outright until he reveals what he truly thinks of her, creating tension as she demands perfect truth about their relationship status.
